13.sabates_a: Jacob's sons answered Sichem & his father in guile, being wrath for the deflowering of their sister:
13.madueke_b: Jacob's sons answered Sichem & his father in guile, being wrath for the deflowering of their sister:

14.s_dismas: We can not doe that which you demande, nor geue our ſiſter to an vncircumciſed perſon: which with vs is an vnlawful & abhominable thing.
14.odr_com: We can not doe that which you demande, nor geue our sister to an vncircumcised person: which with vs is an vnlawful & abhominable thing.
14.sabates_a: We cannot do that which you demand, nor give our sister to an uncircumcised person; which with us is an unlawful & abominable thing.
14.madueke_b: We cannot do that which you demand, nor give our sister to an uncircumcised person; which with us is an unlawful & abominable thing.

15.s_dismas: But in this order we may be confederate, if you wil be like to vs, and al the man ſex among you be circumciſed:
15.odr_com: But in this order we may be confederate, if you wil be like to vs, and al the man sex among you be circumcised:
15.sabates_a: But in this order we may be considerate, if you will be like to us, and all the man sex among you be circumcised:
15.madueke_b: But in this order we may be considerate, if you will be like to us, and all the man sex among you be circumcised:

16.s_dismas: then wil we geue and take mutually your daughters, and ours: and we wil dwel with you, and wil be one people:
16.odr_com: then wil we geue and take mutually your daughters, and ours: and we wil dwel with you, and wil be one people:
16.sabates_a: then will we give and take mutually your daughters, and ours: and we will dwell with you, and will be one people:
16.madueke_b: then will we give and take mutually your daughters, and ours: and we will dwell with you, and will be one people:

17.s_dismas: but if you wil not be circumciſed, we wil take our daughter, and depart.
17.odr_com: but if you wil not be circumcised, we wil take our daughter, and depart.
17.sabates_a: but if you will not be circumcised, we will take our daughter, and depart.
17.madueke_b: but if you will not be circumcised, we will take our daughter, and depart.

18.s_dismas: The offer pleaſed Hemor, and Sichem his ſonne:
18.odr_com: The offer pleased Hemor, and Sichem his sonne:
18.sabates_a: The offer pleased Hemor and Sichem his son:
18.madueke_b: The offer pleased Hemor and Sichem his son:

19.s_dismas: neither did the young man make delay, but forthwith fulfilled that which was demanded: for he loued the wench exceedingly, and he was the greateſt man in al his fathers houſe.
19.odr_com: neither did the young man make delay, but forthwith fulfilled that which was demanded: for he loued the wench exceedingly, and he was the greatest man in al his fathers house.
19.sabates_a: neither did the young man make delay, but forthwith fulfilled that which was demanded: for he loved the wench exceedingly, and he was the greatest man in all his father's house.
19.madueke_b: neither did the young man make delay, but forthwith fulfilled that which was demanded: for he loved the wench exceedingly, and he was the greatest man in all his father's house.

20.s_dismas: And going into the gate of the citie, they ſpake to the people:
20.odr_com: And going into the gate of the citie, they spake to the people:
20.sabates_a: And going into the gate of the city, they spake to the people:
20.madueke_b: And going into the gate of the city, they spake to the people:

21.s_dismas: Theſe men are men of peace, and are willing to dwel with vs: let them occupie in the land, and til it, which being large and wide doth lacke men to tille it: their daughters we ſhal take to wife, and ours we wil geue to them.
21.odr_com: These men are men of peace, and are willing to dwel with vs: let them occupie in the land, and til it, which being large and wide doth lacke men to tille it: their daughters we shal take to wife, and ours we wil geue to them.
21.sabates_a: These men are men of peace, and are willing to dwell with us: let them occupy in the land, and till it, which being large and wide doth lack men to till it: their daughters we shall take to wife, and ours we will give to them.
21.madueke_b: These men are men of peace, and are willing to dwell with us: let them occupy in the land, and till it, which being large and wide doth lack men to till it: their daughters we shall take to wife, and ours we will give to them.

22.s_dismas: One thing there is for the which ſo great a good is differred: If we circumciſe our men ſexe, folowing the rite of the nation.
22.odr_com: One thing there is for the which so great a good is differred: If we circumcise our men sexe, folowing the rite of the nation.
22.sabates_a: One thing there is for the which so great a good is deferred: If we circumcise our men sex, following the rite of the nation.
22.madueke_b: One thing there is for the which so great a good is deferred: If we circumcise our men sex, following the rite of the nation.

23.s_dismas: And their ſubſtance, and cattle, and al things that they poſſeſſe, ſhal be ours: only in this let vs condeſcend, and dwelling togeather, we ſhal make one people.
23.odr_com: And their substance, and cattle, and al things that they possesse, shal be ours: only in this let vs condescend, and dwelling togeather, we shal make one people.
23.sabates_a: And their substance, and cattle, and all things that they possess, shall be ours: only in this let us condescend, and dwelling together we shall make one people.
23.madueke_b: And their substance, and cattle, and all things that they possess, shall be ours: only in this let us condescend, and dwelling together we shall make one people.

24.s_dismas: And they al aſſented, and circumciſed al the man ſex.
24.odr_com: And they al assented, and circumcised al the man sex.
24.sabates_a: And they all assented, and circumcised all the man sex.
24.madueke_b: And they all assented, and circumcised all the man sex.

25.s_dismas: And behold the third day, when the griefe of the woundes is moſt paineful: Iacobs two ſonnes, Simeon and Leui the brothers of Dina, taking their ſwordes, entred into the citie boldly: and killing al the man ſex,
25.odr_com: And behold the third day, when the griefe of the woundes is most paineful: Iacobs two sonnes, Simeon and Leui the brothers of Dina, taking their swordes, entred into the citie boldly: and killing al the man sex,
25.sabates_a: And behold the third day, when the grief of the wounds is most painful: Jacob's two sons Simeon and Levi, the brothers of Dina, taking their swords, entered into the city boldly: and killing all the man sex,
25.madueke_b: And behold the third day, when the grief of the wounds is most painful: Jacob's two sons Simeon and Levi, the brothers of Dina, taking their swords, entered into the city boldly: and killing all the man sex,

26.s_dismas: murdred withal Hemor and Sichem, taking away Dina their ſiſter out of Sichems houſe.
26.odr_com: murdred withal Hemor and Sichem, taking away Dina their sister out of Sichems house.
26.sabates_a: murdered withal Hemor and Sichem, taking away Dina their sister out of Sichem's house.
26.madueke_b: murdered withal Hemor and Sichem, taking away Dina their sister out of Sichem's house.

27.s_dismas: When they were gone forth, the other ſonnes of Iacob ranne in vpon them that were ſlaine: and ſpoiled the citie in reuenge of the rape.
27.odr_com: When they were gone forth, the other sonnes of Iacob ranne in vpon them that were slaine: and spoiled the citie in reuenge of the rape.
27.sabates_a: When they were gone forth, the other sons of Jacob ran in upon them that were slain, and spoiled the city in revenge of the rape.
27.madueke_b: When they were gone forth, the other sons of Jacob ran in upon them that were slain, and spoiled the city in revenge of the rape.

28.s_dismas: And waſting al things that were in their houſes, and fildes, their ſheepe and heardes, and aſſes,
28.odr_com: And wasting al things that were in their houses, and fildes, their sheepe and heardes, and asses,
28.sabates_a: And wasting all things that were in their houses and fields, their sheep and herds, and asses,
28.madueke_b: And wasting all things that were in their houses and fields, their sheep and herds, and asses,

29.s_dismas: their litle ones alſo, and their wiues they led away captiue.
29.odr_com: their little ones also, and their wiues they led away captiue.
29.sabates_a: their little ones also, and their wives they led away captive.
29.madueke_b: their little ones also, and their wives they led away captive.

30.s_dismas: Which things when they had boldly atcheiued, Iacob ſaid to Simeon and Leui: You haue trubled me, and made me odious to the Chananites, and Pherezites the inhabiters of this land. We are few: they being gethered together wil ſtrike me; and I, and my houſe ſhal be deſtroyed.
30.odr_com: Which things when they had boldly atcheiued, Iacob said to Simeon and Leui: You haue trubled me, and made me odious to the Chananites, and Pherezites the inhabiters of this land, we are few: they being gethered together wil strike me; and I, and my house shal be destroyed.
30.sabates_a: Which things when they had boldly achieved, Jacob said to Simeon and Levi: You have troubled me, and made me odious to the Chananites, and Pherezites, the inhabiters of this land. We are few: they being gathered together will strike me; and I and my house shall be destroyed.
30.madueke_b: Which things when they had boldly achieved, Jacob said to Simeon and Levi: You have troubled me, and made me odious to the Chananites, and Pherezites, the inhabiters of this land. We are few: they being gathered together will strike me; and I and my house shall be destroyed.

31.s_dismas: They anſwered: What ſhould they abuſe our ſiſter as a ſtrumpet?
31.odr_com: They answered: What should they abuse our sister as a strumpet?
31.sabates_a: They answered: What? Should they abuse our sister as a strumpet?
31.madueke_b: They answered: What? Should they abuse our sister as a strumpet?

janvier_by_verse.1: And Dina the daughter of Lia went forth to see the women of that country.
janvier_by_verse.2: Whom when Sichem had seen, the son of Hemor the Hevite, the Prince of that land, he was in love with her: and he took her away, and lay with her, by force ravishing the virgin.
janvier_by_verse.3: And his soul was fast knit unto her, and whereas she was sad, he comforted her with sweet words.
janvier_by_verse.4: And going to Hemor his father, he said: Take me this wench to be my wife.
janvier_by_verse.5: Which when Jacob had heard, his sons being absent and occupied in feeding of the cattle, he held his peace till they returned.
janvier_by_verse.6: And when Hemor, Sichem's father was come forth to speak unto Jacob,
janvier_by_verse.7: behold his sons came out of the field; and hearing what had passed, they were passing wrath, because he had done a foul thing in Israel, and committed an unlawful fact in ravishing Jacob's daughter.
janvier_by_verse.8: Hemor therefore spake to them: The soul of my son Sichem is fastened to your daughter: Give her unto him to wife:
janvier_by_verse.9: and let us contract marriages one with another: give us your daughters, and take you our daughters.
janvier_by_verse.10: And dwell with us: the land is at your commandment, till, occupy, and possess it.
janvier_by_verse.11: Yea and Sichem also said to her father and to her brethren: Let me find grace in your sight: and what soever you shall appoint I will give:
janvier_by_verse.12: raise the dowry, and require gifts, and I shall gladly give what you shall demand: only give me this wench to wife.
janvier_by_verse.13: Jacob's sons answered Sichem & his father in guile, being wrath for the deflowering of their sister:
janvier_by_verse.14: We cannot do that which you demand, nor give our sister to an uncircumcised person; which with us is an unlawful & abominable thing.
janvier_by_verse.15: But in this order we may be considerate, if you will be like to us, and all the man sex among you be circumcised:
janvier_by_verse.16: then will we give and take mutually your daughters, and ours: and we will dwell with you, and will be one people:
janvier_by_verse.17: but if you will not be circumcised, we will take our daughter, and depart.
janvier_by_verse.18: The offer pleased Hemor and Sichem his son:
janvier_by_verse.19: neither did the young man make delay, but forthwith fulfilled that which was demanded: for he loved the wench exceedingly, and he was the greatest man in all his father's house.
janvier_by_verse.20: And going into the gate of the city, they spake to the people:
janvier_by_verse.21: These men are men of peace, and are willing to dwell with us: let them occupy in the land, and till it, which being large and wide doth lack men to till it: their daughters we shall take to wife, and ours we will give to them.
janvier_by_verse.22: One thing there is for the which so great a good is deferred: If we circumcise our men sex, following the rite of the nation.
janvier_by_verse.23: And their substance, and cattle, and all things that they possess, shall be ours: only in this let us condescend, and dwelling together we shall make one people.
janvier_by_verse.24: And they all assented, and circumcised all the man sex.

janvier_by_verse.27: When they were gone forth, the other sons of Jacob ran in upon them that were slain, and spoiled the city in revenge of the rape.
janvier_by_verse.28: And wasting all things that were in their houses and fields, their sheep and herds, and asses,
janvier_by_verse.29: their little ones also, and their wives they led away captive.
